card.name: Dosage-form words in product descriptions
card.fires_on: Dosage-form nouns such as solution, gel (in soft gelatin) and mL, or the word Each, in product descriptions and dosing sections. It marks the point where the form or unit of a product is named.

modes.label: Solution wording
modes.description: The word solution after a product descriptor, such as ophthalmic or preservative free.

modes.label: Soft gelatin capsules
modes.description: The start of gelatin inside the phrase soft gelatin capsules.
modes.example: CAUTION: Methoxsalen Capsules, USP 10 mg [Soft<< Gel>>atin Capsules]. This new dosage form

modes.label: Each or mL
modes.description: The word Each or the unit mL that opens a statement of what a unit contains.
modes.example: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Each<< mL>> of the solution provides Zinc 1 mg

card.writes: It seems to add little beyond nudging the next word toward a continuation of the product description, and its promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed.
card.plain: It lights up on words that name the form of a product, like solution or soft gelatin capsule, or that begin a statement of what each unit contains.
